pretreatments.description: Ensilage of giant reed was conducted by supplementing water to achieve a total solids (TS) content of around 40%, packing the substrate into 1-gallon-size zipper bags, vacuuming to minimize oxygen, and storing the samples at room temperature (25 ± 3 °C). Ensilage was performed in triplicate for each of the four harvest dates (August 26, October 3, November 6, December 10), and samples were stored at −20 °C for anaerobic digestion and enzymatic hydrolysis testing after 60 days.

Fungal pretreatment involved inoculating a liquid mycelia suspension of C. subvermispora (ATCC 96608) prepared from 2% malt extract agar plates. This was loaded into 1-L bottles with giant reed, autoclaved at 121 °C for 30 min, and incubated at 28 ± 1 °C for 30 days. The bottles were supplemented with sterilized DI water to adjust moisture content, sealed with cotton stoppers, and incubated before storage at room temperature prior to compositional analysis. The remaining mixture was dried at 40 °C for about 2 days and stored before analysis.
